const recipients = ($input.first().json.data || {}).recipients || [];
return recipients.length === 0 ? [{ json: { none: true } }] : recipients.map((recipient) => ({ json: recipient }));

const results = $input.all().map((item) => (item.json.data || {}).status);
return [{ json: { recipients: results.length, sent: results.filter((s) => s === 'sent').length, failed: results.filter((s) => s === 'failed').length } }];
